name: New England Music Camp
operator_name: Snow Pond Center for the Arts
description_short: A music camp in Sidney, Maine, with three two-week sessions for students ages 9-18 (Session 1) or 11-18 (Sessions 2 and 3). Intensives in chamber music, composition, classical voice and musical theatre are offered in specific sessions.

sessions.name: Session #1: Core Program, Includes Intensive Chamber Music & Composition (also NEMC Prelude for ages 9-10)
Session #2: Core Program, Includes Intensive Chamber Music, Composition, and Classical Voice Intensive
Session #3: Core Program, Includes Intensive Chamber Music, Composition, and Musical Theatre Intensive

warnings: The page lists combo pricing as well as single sessions: Two Session Combo $7200, Three Session Combo $9600. It also says 'Combo Discount: $150-$300 wk for each additional session', which is unclear. price_max reflects the three-session combo.
Other discounts: sibling 10% off (20% for a second sibling), $100 referral credit, 10% off for music educators.
Paying online by credit card adds a flat processing fee. Paying by check, ACH or wire avoids it.
The NEMC Prelude junior program (ages 9-10) runs only in Session #1. Sessions #2 and #3 are for ages 11-18.
Page copyright says 2025, but the dates and tuition shown are for summer 2027.
